blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · What's the difference between nano-hyd…
blocks_element.text: What's the difference between nano-hydroxyapatite and fluoride?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Both options help remineralize and str…
blocks_element.text: Both options help remineralize and strengthen your enamel — they just work in different ways. Nano-Hydroxyapatite (nHAp) is a mineral naturally found in your teeth that helps rebuild enamel by filling in tiny surface imperfections, which can reduce sensitivity and create a smoother, brighter appearance. It’s fluoride-free and safe if accidentally swallowed, making it a great option if you prefer a fluoride-free routine. Fluoride works by reinforcing the tooth’s surface to support enamel strength and help protect against cavities, and is a great option if you prefer a more traditional approach to cavity care. If you already have a preference, you can stick with what works for you — both are effective options for supporting enamel health. Either way, all formulas are free of SLS, parabens, and artificial dyes.
